applicationPool.reason: the strongest entry in the pool. A real CotEditor.xcodeproj AppKit and SwiftUI document application with MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET 14.0 and no LSUIElement, so it has an inspectable main window. It ships Configurations/CodeSigning-AdHoc.xcconfig with CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY = - , an empty DEVELOPMENT_TEAM and a matching CotEditor-AdHoc.entitlements limited to the sandbox, user-selected files and printing, so a local build needs no Developer ID. Offline, operates on local files, and already ships a UI Tests target
applicationPool.candidateDefectsBasis: closed issues carrying the bug label; seven were shortlisted as accessibility-observable and five verified

applicationPool.reason: a real Vienna.xcodeproj Objective-C AppKit application with a storyboard-driven Preferences window, which is a rich accessibility surface. Containment: Codesigning.xcconfig sets CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY = Apple Development, so a local build must override it to ad-hoc, and ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME is on with entitlements that request AppleEvents automation and Sparkle mach-lookup exceptions. The network must be blocked so the first-launch demo feed refresh and the Sparkle update check stay inert; the preference pane under test is entirely offline
applicationPool.candidateDefectsBasis: merged pull requests with fix in the title; four shortlisted, one verified

applicationPool.reason: a real Maccy.xcodeproj SwiftUI application that already ships MaccyUITests, and its Settings window is a genuine inspectable window that needs no Accessibility grant to itself, since Accessibility is only used for auto-paste. Containment is substantial: Info.plist sets LSUIElement true so there is no persistent main window; the project pins DEVELOPMENT_TEAM = MN3X4648SC with automatic signing and hardened runtime, which a local build must override to ad-hoc; the app continuously reads the system pasteboard, which is shared user state; and it carries a Sparkle feed URL, so the network must be blocked
applicationPool.candidateDefectsBasis: closed issues carrying the bug label; one verified

applicationPool.reason: now the best signing story in the pool, better than CotEditor. Verified at both candidate revisions by reading the tree: CodeEdit.xcodeproj is committed, CodeEdit/CodeEditApp.swift declares @main struct CodeEditApp: App with an NSApplicationDelegateAdaptor and a Scene group of real windows, Info.plist sets no LSUIElement, and project.pbxproj carries MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET = 13.0 with DEVELOPMENT_TEAM = "" in all twenty places and CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY[sdk=macosx*] = "-", so an ad-hoc local build needs no override at all. It ships real XCUITest targets, and the January 2025 revisions add ProjectNavigatorFileManagementUITests, which addresses the navigator through popUpButtons, menus, menuItems, outline rows and text field values, which is direct proof the interface is accessibility-addressable. Offline against a local folder, with one containment: Info.plist carries a Sparkle SUFeedURL and the application constructs a SoftwareUpdater at launch, so the network must be blocked for the update check to stay inert, exactly as for Maccy and vienna-rss. Selection must stay away from its terminal, task and source control features
applicationPool.reasonCorrection: an earlier note in this record described CodeEdit as sandboxed with user-selected read-write only. The application group carries a team identifier prefix, which is the one entitlement an ad-hoc build has to be observed to tolerate
applicationPool.candidateDefectsBasis: eighteen commits closing an issue were enumerated from the log; seven were shortlisted as accessibility-observable and two verified

selectedDefects.issueTitle: "New File/Folder" are disabled when the focus is on a document
selectedDefects.frameworkEvidence: native macOS application verified at the affected revision: git ls-tree lists CotEditor.xcodeproj, CotEditor/, Configurations/, Tests and UI Tests; project.pbxproj declares MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET = 14.0; the file the fix touches, CotEditor/Sources/Document Window/File Browser/FileBrowserViewController.swift, is a Swift NSViewController conforming to NSMenuItemValidation, which is AppKit

accessibilityReachability.trigger: AXPress on the file browser Add button, then traverse its AXMenu to the AXMenuItem children
accessibilityReachability.observation: AXEnabled on the New File and New Folder menu items: false at the affected revision, true at the fixed revision, with AXPress a no-op while disabled
accessibilityReachability.note: the fix sets item.target = self for the context menu and Add button menu items so responder chain validation stops disabling them; the added lines sit directly above the file's existing setAccessibilityElement(true) call

signing.evidence: Configurations/CodeSigning-AdHoc.xcconfig is present at the affected revision with CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY = - , CODE_SIGN_STYLE = Manual and an empty DEVELOPMENT_TEAM, pointing at CotEditor-AdHoc.entitlements which requests only the sandbox, user-selected read-write files and printing

selectedDefects.whySuitable: it exercises all three macos-ax adapter primitives in one flow: accessibility tree traversal into a menu, an AXPress action, and an AXEnabled attribute read. No network, no TCC prompt, and the application keeps an ordinary inspectable window
remaining: build both revisions locally with the shipped ad-hoc signing configuration and record the exact command and result
dump the accessibility tree of the built application and confirm the Add button and its menu items appear with the expected roles
state the exact identity and authority for the observable, and minimize the trigger
run three affected reproductions and three fixed controls with a reset application container and reset evidence
record neighboring legal behavior: a menu item that is legitimately disabled must stay disabled on the fixed build

accessibilityReachability.trigger: open an empty folder as the workspace, AXPress the project navigator Add AXPopUpButton, then AXPress the Add File AXMenuItem in its menu
accessibilityReachability.observation: AXValue of the AXTextField in the newly selected navigator row: it reads untitled. with a trailing period at the affected revision and untitled at the fixed revision
accessibilityReachability.note: at the affected revision addFile derives the extension from the most common extension among siblings, which for an empty folder is the empty string, and then unconditionally prefixes a period, producing untitled.
